engine.title: SB Filter
engine.description: Installs the SB entity-filter engine used by SB Entity Browser and SB Watch. Nothing to configure. Afterwards, Add entry creates a named filter.

user.title: New filter

data_description.patterns: Words match the entity id or friendly name, any order, case-insensitive; * and ? wildcards. Words in one pattern must all match.
data_description.areas: The entity's area, else its device's.
data_description.labels: The entity's own labels or its device's.
data_description.classes: class:unit pairs — battery:%, temperature, :°F (either side optional).

error.name_taken: Another filter already has this name.
error.empty: Fill at least one field — a filter that selects nothing is no filter.

abort.already_configured: SB Filter is already set up.
abort.name_taken: A filter with this name exists.
